currentParagraphText: “Rainbowfeather Sovereign. Why have you invaded my domain?”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Rainbowfeather Sovereign. Why have you invaded my domain?”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: The Sovereign, not intimidated in the slightest despite how grotesque the other B-grade looked, crossed his arms and answered. “Invaded? Oh, it must be my misunderstanding. I thought you were having a get-together, seeing as the Forest Fae is allowed here.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: This creature floated up and regarded the Sovereign as it spoke, its voice sounding monotone and genderless, as if someone had changed the void to anonymize it.
